description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor that serves as a base for processing registration events within the OrangeHRM system. It handles task such as retrieving event data, saving registration events, and publishing events via an API connection. It also includes utility functions to gather general organization and user information and define abstract methods to specify event type, data, and whether to save the event.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for processing, saving, and publishing registration events, meant to be extended by concrete event processors.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object responsible for registration event queue operations.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns the service object for communicating with the registration API.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Returns the service object for organization-related data retrieval.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves a registration event if it is to be saved.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers and returns general data related to registration, including user info and system details.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object with provided event time and data.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes pending registration events via API if in production mode, updating their status.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares event data for publishing by adding event type and timestamp.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented, returning the event type as an integer.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented to return specific event data as an array.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented, determining if the event should be saved.
